children: Cronos is bringing prediction and sports markets to its app, letting users trade event contracts on outcomes such as esports matches. The release is scheduled for 17 September 2026 and gives CRO a dated consumer-product catalyst. Availability is limited to select regions, so access depends on where a user is located.

Event-contract trading ties app usage directly to chain activity, since each contract settlement can route volume through Cronos infrastructure. The prediction-market narrative has drawn attention across the industry, and a dated launch gives observers a concrete point to measure engagement. The regional restriction is the main constraint: adoption inside permitted regions determines whether the feature moves meaningful activity, and users elsewhere will not see the markets in the app.
Prediction and sports markets arrive in the Cronos app on 17 September.

title: Cronos: Prediction and Sports Markets Launch in App - 17 Sep 2026
